text.tspan: BASE DIMENSIONS N / FASTENER SIZES AND HOLE LOCATIONS U
Actual dimensions, string data and load-path review required before fabrication or tensioning.
Bond specification, clamp method, cure and through-bolt details: U. Feet shown symbolically; actual
compressed heights govern level and datum A.
For D_foot = 13-14 in, the square side-to-center distance is 4.60-4.95 in. This is smaller than the base
radius. Use actual contact patches and loaded compliance for the final support hull.
Locate the spine shoe, backing structure and any braces from the reviewed frame joint. The circular
base outline does not specify bolt centers. Include base bending, local bearing, pull-through and joint
Record each foot center (x, y), patch size, compressed height, fastener ID and mounting surface. Verify four
contacts without rocking. Plot the loaded center-of-gravity projection on M03.
